# Holden Health

> Personalized online and in-person fitness and nutrition coaching with Kelsey Holden, a certified personal trainer and nutrition coach based in Metro Detroit, Michigan. The approach is habit-based and sustainable: small, doable changes that fit real life, no crash diets and no all-or-nothing.

## About Kelsey Holden
- NPTI Certified Personal Trainer (2011)
- Precision Nutrition Level 1 Certified (certified 2019; active through August 2028)
- AFAA Certified Group Fitness Instructor (active through July 2028)
- B.S. in Exercise Science and a Master's in Orthotics & Prosthetics, both from Eastern Michigan University
- Opened her first studio, It's Fitness Time, in Ann Arbor (2011); ran Fitness Time Dayton (2018), which became Holden Health
- Mom of two; also coaches at Orangetheory

## Coaching programs (all online, monthly, no contracts)
- Fitness Coaching ($199/month): 1:1 consult, custom workouts in an app updated weekly, weekly check-ins, 24/7 coach access
- Nutrition Coaching ($199/month): daily skill lessons, daily coach check-ins, weekly habit goals, bi-weekly video chats, no rigid meal plans
- Training + Nutrition ($299/month): the complete system, both programs combined
- Metro Detroit small-group bootcamp (coming soon, in-person; join the interest list)
